exposure: extra amniotic Normal saline insertion via Foley catheter followed by misoprostol
cohort: 107 patients undergoing second-trimester medical termination of pregnancy between 13 and 28 weeks of gestation.
finding: The extra amniotic method demonstrated high success with acceptable induction-abortion intervals and low complication rates for second-trimester medical termination.
mod_finding: The extra amniotic method was associated with high success and low complication rates, while the mifepristone-misoprostol combination showed moderate induction-to-expulsion time.
